items.text:
Не совсем игра, скорее интерактивная анимированная сценка.
Как некое произведение авторское - достойно, есть перевод, может быть, какие-то мысли главного героя срезонируют с Вашими, особенно, если у Вас был опыт подобных "свиданий" (когда всё было приготовлено, но девушка не пришла). Атмосфера выдержана неплохо.
Жаль, что потенциал не раскрыт, можно было бы сделать какие-нибудь элементы реиграбельности, или определенный набор действий, чтобы девушка всё-таки явилась (когда ГГ пьяный и поевший).
Если нужна +1 иконка - можно взять, хотя бы не мусор, вещь запоминающаяся.
items.text_zh:
不完全是游戏，更像是一个互动动画小品。
作为某种作者作品——还算不错，有翻译，也许主角的某些想法会与你产生共鸣，尤其是如果你有过类似“约会”的经历（一切都准备好了，但女孩没来）。氛围营造得不错。
遗憾的是潜力没有被挖掘出来，本可以加入一些重玩性元素，或者一套特定的操作，让女孩最终还是出现（当主角喝醉并且吃饱之后）。
如果需要+1图标——可以入手，至少不是垃圾，是个令人印象深刻的东西。

observations.description: 潜力未发挥，缺少重玩性或让女孩出现的行动选择
observations.evidence: Жаль, что потенциал не раскрыт, можно было бы сделать какие-нибудь элементы реиграбельности, или определенный набор действий, чтобы девушка всё-таки явилась
observations.evidence_zh: 遗憾的是潜力没有被发掘出来，本可以加入一些重玩性元素，或者设定一套特定的操作，让女孩最终还是出现

items.text:
This was an experience really destroyed by having any expectations and paying money.

I went into it really happy to see something like this, but man did it fall short. It is about 15 minutes long and there's basically nothing to do or affect. The subject matter was so banal that I spent the whole time waiting for a breaththrough that just doesn't happen.

I think it is also misleading by saying you "become the subconscious" of the main character. Because you don't, you just hear it, and the only think you control is some conscious decision making (like pouring wine) and order of operations. In that way, it's a kind of interesting slightly experimental movie, but it's far from any roleplay possibilities offered by using a videogame over a short film.

I did like a lot of the visual design. The objects were well designed and the icons conveyed their points well while working with the theme. The acting was good.

I really wanted to like it. I think it's an interesting portfolio piece for all involved. But it's not worth paying for.
items.text_zh:
这本来是一次被任何期望和花钱彻底毁掉的体验。

我进去的时候真的很高兴能看到这样的东西，但天哪，它差得太远了。它大约15分钟长，基本上没有什么可做或可影响的。题材如此平庸，以至于我全程都在等待一个根本不会发生的突破。

我觉得说你会“成为主角的潜意识”也是误导。因为你并没有，你只是听到它，你唯一能控制的就是一些有意识的决策（比如倒酒）和操作顺序。那样的话，它算是一种有点意思、略微实验性的电影，但远不及使用电子游戏而非短片所能提供的任何角色扮演可能性。

我确实喜欢很多视觉设计。物品设计得很好，图标在配合主题的同时很好地传达了它们的含义。表演也不错。

我真的很想喜欢它。我认为对所有参与者来说，这是一件有趣的 portfolio 作品。但它不值得花钱。

observations.description: 玩家只能控制部分有意识决策和操作顺序，无法真正成为潜意识
observations.evidence: you just hear it, and the only think you control is some conscious decision making (like pouring wine) and order of operations
observations.evidence_zh: 你只是听到它，而你唯一能控制的是一些有意识的决策（比如倒酒）和操作顺序

items.text:
[h1]Short Review[/h1]
If you came here thinking this was a dinner date simulator, you are very wrong. Dinner Date is an extremely linear and rather boring game. There is absolutely no replay-ability since there is nothing to deviate from/variables to change during the playthrough. The chapters proceed from Introduction -> The Clock -> The Bread -> The Soup -> The Cigarettes. At least everything ends in 25 minutes.

[h1]Score[/h1]
Very Bad
- 3/10
items.text_zh:
[h1]简短评测[/h1]
如果你来这里以为这是个晚餐约会模拟器，那你就大错特错了。《晚餐约会》是一款极其线性且相当无聊的游戏。完全没有重玩价值，因为在游玩过程中没有任何可以偏离的地方或可以改变的变量。章节依次从介绍 -> 时钟 -> 面包 -> 汤 -> 香烟推进。至少一切都在25分钟内结束。

[h1]评分[/h1]
非常糟糕
- 3/10

observations.description: 游戏完全线性，没有可改变的内容，缺乏重玩价值
observations.evidence: There is absolutely no replay-ability since there is nothing to deviate from/variables to change during the playthrough.
observations.evidence_zh: 绝对没有任何重玩价值，因为整个流程中没有任何可以偏离的内容或可改变的变量。

items.text:
This isn't so much a game as it is an interactive short story. It takes about 20 minutes to listen to and it is eh. I don't really see the point in it being a game considering you don't have any choices and you only listen yourself ramble about fairly innocous things. 

Like cool, you got stood up but what is the point of this game? There is no lesson or overwhelmingly good story that comes out of this besides listening to banality of some 27 year old guy who got stood up.
items.text_zh:
这与其说是一个游戏，不如说是一个互动短篇故事。听完大约需要20分钟，也就那样。考虑到你没有任何选择，只是听你自己唠叨一些相当无聊的事情，我真看不出它作为一个游戏有什么意义。

就好像，很酷，你被放鸽子了，但这个游戏的意义是什么？除了听一个27岁被放鸽子的家伙的乏味唠叨之外，这里面没有任何教训或特别好的故事。

items.text: This "game" was very boring and felt very disengaging. While the game offers choice, the choices are completely meaningless. After "finishing" the game, I was extremely disappointed with this "game". Please save your money and buy something else.
items.text_zh: 这个“游戏”非常无聊，让人感觉很出戏。虽然游戏提供了选择，但这些选择完全毫无意义。在“通关”游戏后，我对这个“游戏”极度失望。请省下你的钱，去买点别的吧。

observations.description: 游戏提供的选择完全没有意义
observations.evidence_zh: 这些选择完全毫无意义

items.text: Not much of gamplay or choice...and it is mentioned at the start that you don't have freedom of choice. This game made me feel miserable and old, sad and afraid of my future dates...if I will ever get to have any...I will go now and cry in a pillow...feeling unfulfilled and underachieved...mediocre and insignificant...
items.text_zh: 没有多少玩法或选择……而且开头就提到你没有选择的自由。这款游戏让我感到痛苦又苍老，悲伤并害怕自己未来的约会……如果我能有机会拥有任何约会的话……我现在要去用枕头捂着脸哭了……感觉不满足、未达成……平庸又微不足道……

observations.description: 游戏缺乏玩法和选择，开头就说明没有选择自由
observations.evidence: Not much of gamplay or choice...and it is mentioned at the start that you don't have freedom of choice.
observations.evidence_zh: 没什么玩法或选择……而且开头就提到你没有选择的自由。

items.text:
Dinner Date is not a game. That is to say, loading it up and playing it doesn't expose you to anything you might consider gameplay. It is an intellectual experiment, trying to create art from a gaming perspective. Unfortunately what comes out is something that is so pretentious it seems to have been sucked through it's own rear end and into a completely different reality.

Now, if this was a free to download and try experiment at merging gaming and art I probably would be more positive towards it. But this is a priced experience, you don't simply get to try something new, you have to pay for it. And you don't get much for your money.

You play as Julian Luxemburg, or rather, as his subconscious as he sits around, nervously waiting for his date to arrive, you get to hear his inner monologue, fidget with the various items on the table and drum your fingers a bit. And that's really it, that's the entire experience. The subtle differences that can occur from taking different actions are so minute that it's hardly worth a second playthrough.

Only bright side to this experience is the above average voice acting of Julian but that alone doesn't add much.

All in all, this is quite simply a travesty. I am all for game developers experimenting and trying new things but when you are charging me money for 10 minutes of listening to someone worry about life that's just attempting to cash in on the bizarreness of your creation. Do not buy this, it is not worth your time and even if you're into this sort of art, there are much better experiences outside of the gaming medium.
items.text_zh:
《Dinner Date》不是一款游戏。也就是说，加载并游玩它并不会让你接触到任何你可能认为是玩法的东西。它是一个智力实验，试图从游戏的角度创造艺术。不幸的是，最终出来的东西是如此自命不凡，以至于它似乎被从自己的屁股里吸了进去，进入了一个完全不同的现实。

现在，如果这是一个可以免费下载并尝试的、融合游戏与艺术的实验，我可能会对它更积极一些。但这是一个需要付费的体验，你不能只是尝试某种新东西，你必须为它付钱。而你花这些钱得不到多少东西。

你扮演朱利安·卢森堡，或者更确切地说，扮演他的潜意识，他坐在那里，紧张地等待他的约会对象到来，你能听到他的内心独白，摆弄桌子上的各种物品，用手指敲一敲。真的就这些，这就是整个体验。采取不同行动可能产生的细微差别小到几乎不值得再玩一遍。

这个体验唯一的亮点是朱利安高于平均水平的配音，但仅凭这一点也加不了多少分。

总而言之，这简直是一场闹剧。我完全支持游戏开发者进行实验和尝试新事物，但当你为听某人担心生活10分钟而向我收费时，那只是在试图利用你作品的怪异性来捞钱。不要买这个，它不值得你花时间，即使你对这类艺术感兴趣，在游戏媒介之外也有好得多的体验。

observations.description: 不同操作带来的差异极其微小，不值得重玩
observations.evidence: The subtle differences that can occur from taking different actions are so minute that it's hardly worth a second playthrough.
observations.evidence_zh: 采取不同行动可能产生的细微差别是如此微小，以至于几乎不值得再玩第二遍。
